k01-week.observed_description: The approved 4.9 whiteboard month calendar (header 05 / 2023, dates 1 to 31 in seven columns, small drawings in boxes 1 to 7) with one long dark-blue freehand loop around the whole first row, boxes 1 to 7. Every date is unchanged; no letters or words.
k01-week.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared four_card false): one loop around seven days reads as a week at 180 px.

k02-days.observed_description: The same whiteboard month calendar with three separate dark-blue freehand loops, one each around boxes 2, 3 and 4 of the first row. Every date is unchanged; no letters or words.
k02-days.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared four_card false): three separately looped days read at 180 px.

k03-weekend.observed_description: The same whiteboard month calendar with one dark-blue freehand loop around boxes 6 and 7 together, the last two days of the first row. Every date is unchanged; no letters or words.
k03-weekend.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared four_card false): the two looped end-of-week days read at 180 px.

k04-tomorrow-tuesday.observed_description: The approved Monday board, with its blue loop around box 1, plus a short dark-blue curved arrow from the loop into box 2, its arrowhead beside the 2. Every date is unchanged; no letters or words.
k04-tomorrow-tuesday.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared four_card false): the arrow from the looped day to the next reads at 250 px and is small but visible at 180 px.

k05-tomorrow-thursday.observed_description: The approved Wednesday board, with its blue loop around box 3, plus a thick dark-blue curved arrow from the loop into box 4, its arrowhead beside the 4. Every date is unchanged; no letters or words.
k05-tomorrow-thursday.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared four_card false): the arrow from the looped day to the next reads at 180 px.

k06-tomorrow-saturday.observed_description: The approved Friday board, with its blue loop around box 5, plus a thick dark-blue curved arrow from the loop into box 6, its arrowhead above the tree drawing beside the 6. Every date is unchanged; no letters or words.
k06-tomorrow-saturday.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared four_card false): the arrow from the looped day to the next reads at 180 px.

k07-year.observed_description: A wooden-framed whiteboard year planner photographed straight on: the header 2023 in black marker and twelve equal boxes in three rows of four, numbered 1 to 12 in order in their top left corners, each with two small faint grids of empty squares and no digits. No letters, words or pen marks.
k07-year.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared four_card false): 2023 and twelve numbered boxes read as a year at 180 px. The board is more worn and its frame darker than the 4.9 month board, and each box has two small grids instead of the one the prompt asked for.

k08-month.observed_description: The whiteboard year planner (header 2023, twelve boxes numbered 1 to 12) with one dark-blue freehand loop around the single box 5. All numbers are unchanged; no letters or words.
k08-month.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared four_card false): one looped month box reads at 180 px.

k09-months.observed_description: The whiteboard year planner (header 2023, twelve boxes numbered 1 to 12) with three separate dark-blue freehand loops, one each around boxes 2, 3 and 4. All numbers are unchanged; no letters or words.
k09-months.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared four_card false): three separately looped month boxes read at 180 px.
